transcript: Welcome to the 2024.2 New Feature videos. In this video, we will look at the improvements to the Add Thickness option. All thickness-related options have been grouped under one category named Geometry, providing easier access than previously. Adding an Extrusion option to set the extrusion direction of your pattern's thickness, and Visibility option allows you to turn on and off the visibility of certain faces of your pattern. Set Garment Display option to Wireframe on Monochrome to identify the thickness and other geometry options. By adjusting the value on Additional Thickness option, you can increase or decrease the thickness of your pattern. There are three different options in Extrusion direction . Forward will give you the additional thickness to the front side, Normal side. Both will give thickness to both front and back side of your pattern. Backward will give you the additional thickness to the back side . Under Extrusion Direction, you have options to choose the visibility of front face, back face, and lastly the seam face. When you turn off the front face checkmark, you will not see the front part of your cloth. And when you turn off the front face checkmark, you will not see the front part of your cloth. When you turn off the back face checkmark, and turn the front face back on, you only get to see the front part of your cloth. And when you turn on the Seam Face checkbox, it will show you the faces on overlapping sides on the sewn line. On Side geometry, you have Curvature, Resolution, and Double-sided options. Resolution is directly related to the resolution of the geometry. The higher the number, the better quality the geometry you will get. Curvature only works when you have enough resolution on the geometry. If you lower the value of curvature when you don't have enough resolution, you lose curvature and the geometry will appear flat. Turning on the double-sided option will give double-sided geometry to your pattern. Thank you for watching!
summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024.2: Add Thickness ## Introduction Welcome to the 2024.2 New Feature videos. In this video, we will look at the improvements to the Add Thickness option. ## Geometry Category All thickness-related options have been grouped under one category named **Geometry**, providing easier access than previously. ## Extrusion Option The **Extrusion** option allows you to set the extrusion direction of your pattern's thickness. ### Direction Options There are three different options in the extrusion direction: - **Forward**: Adds additional thickness to the front side (Normal side). - **Both**: Adds thickness to both the front and back sides of your pattern. - **Backward**: Adds additional thickness to the back side. ## Visibility Options The **Visibility** option allows you to turn on and off the visibility of certain faces of your pattern. Under the extrusion direction, you have options to choose the visibility of: - Front face - Back face - Seam face ### Face Visibility Behavior - When you turn off the **front face** checkmark, you will not see the front part of your cloth. - When you turn off the **back face** checkmark and turn the front face back on, you will only see the front part of your cloth. - When you turn on the **Seam Face** checkbox, it will show you the faces on overlapping sides on the sewn line. ## Side Geometry Options On the **Side Geometry**, you have: - **Curvature** - **Resolution** - **Double-sided** options. ### Resolution Resolution is directly related to the quality of the geometry. The higher the number, the better quality the geometry you will get. ### Curvature Curvature only works when you have enough resolution on the geometry. If you lower the value of curvature when you don't have enough resolution, you will lose curvature, and the geometry will appear flat. ### Double-sided Option Turning on the **double-sided** option will give double-sided geometry to your pattern. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! ```
